system.description: Prime Requisite: Strength. Other Requirements: Constitution 9 or better. Experience Bonus: 5% for Strength 13-15, 10% for Strength 16-18. Hit Dice: 1d8 per level up to 9th level. Starting with 10th level, + 3 hp per level and Constitution adjustments no longer apply. Armor: Any; shields permitted. Weapons: Any Small or Medium melee weapon; short bows and crossbows permitted, but longbows forbidden. Special Abilities: Fighter Maneuvers (Lance Attack and Set Spear vs.
